question: In 2018, which nuclear reactor did BARC re-commission with double capacity compared to its earlier version?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Apsara**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Apsara** is the nuclear reactor that BARC re-commissioned in 2018 with double the capacity compared to its earlier version.
 
• Apsara is significant as it was the first nuclear reactor in Asia.
 
• The re-commissioning of Apsara marks a significant milestone in India's nuclear research capabilities.
 
• The upgraded reactor is expected to enhance the scope of nuclear research and development in various fields including neutron activation analysis and radiation damage studies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **BARC** stands for Bhabha Atomic Research Centre, which is India's premier nuclear research facility.
 
• BARC was established in 1954 and has been at the forefront of India's nuclear research and development.
 
• The re-commissioning of Apsara is part of BARC's ongoing efforts to maintain and expand India's nuclear research infrastructure.
 
• The upgraded Apsara reactor will also support various applications in medicine, agriculture, and industry.
